attributes.text: User prioritised fractional and contract enquiries, remote-friendly engagements with Bristol by arrangement, and a broad offering without an invented niche. Working canvas is the preferred visual basis; soften harsh backgrounds but retain some contrast. These are conversation rulings, not acceptance of the newly drafted plan corpus. Recorded 2026-09-08; full sequence in design/decision-history.md.

User explicitly ruled that launch needs email capture and an enquiry, not AI chat; the previous quiz need not be copied. Getting public soon is a priority. AI chat may return later. Recorded 2026-09-08.

User likes the current design language, requests Execution fu to explain the Kung Fu reference, and requests at least one white male in the avatar fan alongside the other portraits to reflect likely clients. Latest homepage image applies both corrections. Recorded 2026-09-08.

Agent recommends leaving the four-threshold pricing meter outside the launch enquiry path. Source review found five multi-select questions, role scoring, preselected price calibration and an AI-conversation Send action without an email field. Meter deferral remains a recommendation, not a user ruling.
